_meta.note: Test fixture for npc-story-events NR1.2 (the real file is narrative-seed's).

none.description: The outcome does nothing beyond its effects.
none.negative: Not 'no effect': the outcome's effects still apply.

loot.description: The host's loot draw at this outcome's drop band.
loot.negative: Not a named item; the runtime rolls it.

scout.description: The party's sight radius for the room.
scout.negative: Not a map reveal outside the room.

quest.offer.description: The quest engine offers a narrative quest anchor.
quest.offer.negative: Not a quest definition; the storylet names a quest anchor, it never writes one.

relation.shift.description: One relation fact about a target, from which the ledger derives a band.
relation.shift.negative: Not a number of steps and not a direction; never about an enemy-side role.

recruit.description: Ownership transfer of the cast character, or the wild-join intake.

scene.play.description: The scene player plays a spine scene.

battle.start.description: A battle request into an existing battle mode.
battle.start.negative: Not encounter; never a Delve room fight.

doctrine.setback.description: The antagonist's study falls back, inside the world Events phase.
doctrine.setback.negative: Not a relation change and not an amount: how far it falls back is tuning.
